info.title: Reducto direct agent signup
info.description: Cookie-free registration for a new user at a new company. Requires an emailed code, name, and explicit terms consent. Existing accounts and companies use Studio. Standard grant: 15,000 credits.

post.summary: Check eligibility and email a verification code
post.description: No account or billing records are created. Codes expire after 10 minutes; five incorrect attempts. Resending supersedes the previous challenge. Wait 60 seconds between sends; five/email/hour, ten/IP/hour. Responses and tokens must not be logged.

400.description: Show error.message and error.field in the terminal. Correct invalid_input or ask for the emailed code on invalid_code. If error.restart_required is true, start a new code request after corrections and the resend cooldown.

403.description: Show the email-policy reason in error.message and ask for an eligible work email. Retry signup with that email.

409.description: Continue in Studio. Show error.message and studio_url to the user; joining an existing organization requires Studio.

410.description: Show error.message and request a new verification code after the resend cooldown.

429.description: Show error.message and wait Retry-After seconds before retrying.

503.description: Show error.message and retry the same request after Retry-After. Respect the resend cooldown for an interrupted initial code request.

post.summary: Verify consent and ownership, provision, and deliver the API key
post.description: Repeat the identical request after Retry-After until 200. Do not start a second signup while provisioning. Successful delivery is encrypted at rest for 10 minutes; only the original verification request can retrieve it again. After delivery expiry use Studio; no key recovery or rotation here.

200.description: Provisioned. Store api_key privately as REDUCTO_API_KEY; never print or commit the response.

202.description: Provisioning. Wait, then repeat the identical request.

400.description: Show error.message and error.field in the terminal. Correct invalid_input or ask for the emailed code on invalid_code. If error.restart_required is true, start a new code request after corrections and the resend cooldown.

message.description: Human-readable error and next steps. Display in the agent's terminal.

field.description: The request field to correct, when applicable.

restart_required.description: User creation rejected these fields. Correct them and request a new signup code after the resend cooldown.
